name: get_influence
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();plan=dict(url='https://arxiv.org/pdf/0909.5652',routes=['319062'],destination='sources/influence.pdf',source_identity='Christofides Influences of monotone Boolean functions',purpose='Authenticate exact public proof and full monotone influence bridge')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'influence-plan.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'source_get_guard.py'),str(p/'influence-plan.json')],text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
